biotools.summary: hDNApipe is a bash and Python-based pipeline for analyzing human genomic sequencing data, designed to streamline the process with an intuitive user interface and efficient workflow. It provides both command-line and graphical user interface options and includes a dedicated Docker setup for easy installation.
